markdown_content: ## The problem of extrapolation The schemes we have employed so far are a little idealistic in that they assume the same data distribution in the test set as seen during training. Actually this can be unusual in the physical sciences and engineering since we are often interested in making discoveries (i.e., exploring new data domains) with our models. Here's a schematic illustrating the difference between **interpolation** and **extrapolation**: How can we address this? By using **groups** to investigate how the models perform on data towards the center of the distribution versus the edges!
